title: The Pod: the real unit of execution, and why you never create one by hand

videos.script: Kubernetes does not run containers. It runs pods. A pod is one or more containers that share an address, a hostname and, if you ask, a disk. {{pod}} You will build one by hand, with three containers. One runs first and leaves a file. Two run side by side and talk over localhost. {{three}} Then you will stop one container behind the cluster's back, and watch the kubelet start it again inside the same pod. {{restart}} And then you will delete the pod. It does not come back. Nothing was watching it. {{gone}} That is the whole argument for the next lesson. A pod is the unit that runs, and a controller is the thing that keeps it running. {{controller}}
